title: Relay Hack x Aqore, first place
summary: A twelve-day build sprint on the Staffing Software Innovation Challenge, a domain that is common globally but still early in Nepal. Working with two teammates I owned the candidate screening and shortlisting subsystem, a database-driven solution that ranks applicants against a role's requirements. We took first place.
